rationale: Revision 3 corrects the material product-scope error in v2. It makes permissionless developer access explicit while preserving objective proof, authorization and financial predicates; requires a bound ZKIRv3 artifact and actual Midnight behavior; and recovers certified-basis work without adopting unsupported claims of already-proved native jets. Its observable logical-work, arbitrary-witness soundness, valid-execution completeness and call-site precondition requirements agree with my source audit. The APSS separation and optional-router boundary agree with the Applications literature. This is an architecture endorsement, not proof or implementation acceptance.
caveats: Jet equivalence must preserve the complete declared observation relation. A constant replacement cost is insufficient for an input-dependent reference cost or different failure prefix. The candidate correctly requires unchanged logical work or a new profile.

Outstanding equals principal plus accrued is presently supported by runtime invariant checks, not a completed transparent-substitution theorem. Post-state provenance, lookup/unit/range conditions, errors and work remain theorem hypotheses.
A small constructor basis does not eliminate codec, financial-effect, witness, commitment, privacy or composition obligations. Fifteen is an exploratory count, not a proof-budget guarantee.

I inspected the local Simplicity, recovered Moriarty and local ZKIRv3 instruction sources. I did not independently rebuild or audit the specific PR17 Agda artifact named in section 3, nor verify current deployed Midnight phase behavior. The plan appropriately treats their assumptions and deployed correspondence as open; exact supporting research records must remain attached.

The Applications literature is a bounded 12-source first pass with twelve visually inspected PDF pages. It is not exhaustive coverage or evidence that those foreign applications are implemented on Midnight.

Permissionless access does not make invalid witnesses, arbitrary verifiers, missing user authority or undeclared external assumptions acceptable. Application-specific policy remains scoped to its contract and participants.
A0/A1 usefulness gates must genuinely permit deferral; the general source-to-ZKIRv3 proof path remains the primary deliverable.
evidence_that_would_change_vote: A public compile/prove/deploy path that requires Moriarty reviewer identity, project campaign approval, a hosted solver account or a central program allowlist would contradict this endorsed design.

A certified primitive whose constraints accept a non-reference malicious witness, or whose composition omits range/Boolean/effect preconditions, would block its adoption regardless of honest-generator tests.
A jet rewrite that changes work exhaustion, rejection order or remaining work without explicit versioning would invalidate transparency claims.

Evidence that the selected actual Midnight/ZKIRv3 acceptance path cannot enforce required correctness/intent/history or complete failure effects would require a revised implementation route, not removal of those obligations.
A measured authoring corpus that shows no useful improvement from A1/A3 would favor deferring those enhancements while preserving the compiler/proof objective.
